title: Max Davis's first skeptical reaction to Josiah's messages

tellings.quote: trying to get something from me it actually made her cry cuz I'm a skeptic so that's how it began

plain: Max Davis, who speaks in an episode about the Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about children said to read minds, describes how skeptical he was at first about messages from a boy named Josiah. He says that when she tried to get something from him, it made her cry, "cuz I'm a skeptic," and that this is how it all began.
